title: Orthodox Samaritan fashion
html_source: An obvious allusion to “the Good Samaritan” (Luke 10:33). The Good Samaritan helped an injured robbery victim after a priest and Levite just passed him by. The story epitomizes the virtue of kindness to strangers and the ignored.
